x: Reading romped away with the title - helped by our old friend Dick Piotrowski in 37th place. Their total of 137 points went quite unchallenged.

Two ex-Belgravians up ahead of him were Dick Piotrowski (Reading) 5th in 30:59 and Doug Brew (unattached) 38th in 35:42. On November 11th George finished 29th in the Hampshire 10 miles road race championship at Southampton in 63:43.

There was no stopping Bernie Ford who took Aldershot ahead for the first time with his 23:38, only 17 seconds outside his course record set in far less blustery conditions Laurie O'Hara moved up to 19th with 26:06, overtaking ex-Belgravian Dick Piotrowski (Reading) in the process.
